_comment: Value corrections applied by cm_build.py. null_ranges: values nulled (e.g. a dead sensor). offset_ranges: a constant added to the value (e.g. a sonde redeployed with a wrong depth reference). Dates are local (America/New_York) and inclusive; an end of 9999-12-31 means still in effect. cm_build.py warns when a nulled value is nonzero (e.g. after a sensor repair). The fix_*.py scripts apply the same correction once to rows loaded before it existed (recorded in ingest_runs under the entry's id).

null_ranges.reason: the WS3 anemometer has reported only zeros since 2025-03-26 18:30 (CORAL dropped these columns from the 2026-01-23 to 2026-04-30 brick for the same reason)

null_ranges.reason: the L8-SZ1 Aqua TROLL 600 stopped transmitting on 2026-10-11 (S. Shekhar, 2026-11-09); the few readings since (2026-10-23, 10-28, 11-06, 11-07) report 56-60 C and 3,000-4,800 uS/cm, so the sonde is failing, not reporting. Remove this entry when it is replaced or repaired.

labels: depth, top=ground surface, bottom=water surface, ft
offset_ranges.reason: the L9-SZ2 Aqua TROLL 600 came back from its 2026-09-23 service out of calibration: its depth to water reads 4.07 ft too shallow (S. Shekhar, 2026-11-09, from manual depths; L9-SZ1 in the same well reads as expected). Offset = the change in the hour-aligned SZ1 - SZ2 difference from before (2025-10-01..2026-09-22, mean -0.15 ft, n=5430) to after (2026-09-24..2026-11-06, mean +3.92 ft, n=893); residual spread 0.17 ft matches the zones' normal difference. Remove this entry when the sonde is recalibrated.
